description: A formal yet inviting sitting room in a clean, Parisian-influenced neutral palette. A wainscoting rail divides the lower third of the wall. Atop the sideboard: a large, generously full vase of white hydrangeas and trailing eucalyptus in a textured cream ceramic pitcher, a small sculptural knot or abstract object in natural stone tone, a few stacked coffee table books, and a simple cream bookend pairing. In the foreground, two low-slung rounded bouclé armchairs in off-white cream face each other — their fully upholstered, curved, pillow-back form is soft and casual-luxe. One chair has a chunky oatmeal knit blanket thrown over its arm; both hold a warm taupe or greige linen lumbar cushion. A round glass-top and walnut-base coffee table at the lower left holds a ceramic mug and stacked books. A natural jute area rug grounds the seating area. Two warm columns of soft globular light glow symmetrically from wall positions flanking the sideboard, their warm diffuse wash pooling across the white paneled wall.
